reviews.title: what a great airline serving the North
reviews.text: I could not believe the excellent service this regional airline gave.Everyone from those at the counter ,the pilots and crew did their utmost to see you were enjoying every aspect of the flight from the time i booked the flight to the time i returned to Montreal.
reviews.author: Jack H

reviews.title: They Know the Meaning of Customer Service
reviews.text: Established in 1946 as Bradley Air Services (and still registered under that name), First Air began passenger service in 1973. From its establishment and to the current day, First Air served – and serves – a vital role in Canada’s far north as both passenger and cargo transport. Akin to the great white north itself, First Air has had a very intriguing history that, much like the remote communities it serves, has had many an up and down. For example, often in competition with rival carrier Canadian North, First Air has typically vied for a fairly slim market in the Northwest Territories and Nunavut. Indeed, because the population is so sparse in Canada’s far north, I suspect that positive profit margins for both airlines were slim to non-existent. As such, the two airlines have talked about merging on and off since at least 2014. Much to my personal chagrin, a merger between the two airlines was finally approved in June of this year and came into effect on 1 November 2019. I say “much to my personal chagrin” because under the terms of this merger, “First Air” will essentially cease to exist (and with it goes the oldest airline in Canada operating under its original name), and all flights will be carried out under the “Canadian North” name BUT utilize the new – corporatized and bland – First Air livery. Personally, I preferred the much more colourful Aurora and Animal tails of the “old” First Air over the stylized inuksuk. C’est la vie, I guess. C’est la vie. In any event, I’d
reviews.author: PookyCake

reviews.title: Expensive flight On First Air
reviews.text: Flying to Yellowknife is economical now that WestJet has brought some competition into that market. However to continue on to a smaller community such as Fort Simpson is a financial disaster. A one way flight of approximately 1 hr that would be in $200-$300 range in southern Canada came in at over $900 One way and they call it a Saver fare! First Air knows many of the passengers are on medical travel paid for by the govt. Many drive the 6 hours instead.
reviews.author: Timothy G

reviews.title: A rare treat for domestic Travel
reviews.text: What a pleasant change from Air Canada or Westjet domestic flights! Staff are super friendly and efficient. Legroom is limited, but par for the course. The planes are somewhat dated, but comfortable enough. Real complementary snacks/sandwiches are served. On my evening flight back to Edmonton, they even provided a hot snack (acceptable perogies) and complimentary wine. I felt like I was treated as a person, not a number. Don't get me wrong - this is not Singapore business class or anything, but if get a chance to travel with them, don't hesitate. Please also keep in mind that extreme weather in the north, combined with small, basic airports, can frequently lead to delays and cancellations. This, of course, is not the fault of the airline. I traveled on Aeroplan points - very good value.
reviews.author: LaoBanDad

reviews.title: What a treat to travel on this airline!
reviews.text: Check in was fast, no waiting in line with only a few agents present. The service on the plane was excellent and there was food provided. A special treat a hot chocolate chip cookie for dessert. The staff were friendly and the leg room adequate. I wish they flew to more destinations.
reviews.author: Val C

reviews.title: Heading North
reviews.text: This flight was on time and the check in efficient. The seats old and leg room limited. In flight crew were good and friendly. Food was eatable and the coffee not good. 1.75 hours in flight was short enough to tolerate and the baggage retrieval at Inuvik was great.
reviews.author: sutty581

reviews.title: Some differences from the norm.
reviews.text: Good service enroute - great chocolate-chip cookies and 'special' coffee. Very expensive unless you're a local (not like you have any options beyond a charter or flying yourself). Flights may be open-seating, depending on loading. Many flights are 'combi's' w/less seating than you may think, due to freight carriage. Be aware that the terminal in YFB is split between a non-secure and secure portion, w/o much for signage or information (or a direct connection). If you are traveling 'up-island' (non-secure), you need to find your way to the proper terminal section to catch your flight, and ditto for 'down-island' (secure) flights.
reviews.author: Iver E S

reviews.title: Impressive
reviews.text: My wife and I traveller’s to Santa Maria with Sunwing on First Air. The personnel was great and providence excellent service.
reviews.author: Michel L

reviews.title: Always the worst service in EIA
reviews.text: I’ve travelled a fair bit in my time and the check in agents for first air never fail to disappoint. I checked in this morning and the lady was very rude and dismissive. We pay so much to fly on first air, you’d think that the service would be outstanding! It’s when you get on the first air flights to the smaller communities is when you’ll find the nice ones. Last time I’ll fly first air through here, such an ugly way to start the day.
reviews.author: Jenn

reviews.title: A good option when flying north
reviews.text: Good airline but not great, it brings you where you need to be when you need to be, no frizzles, no sparkling stuff... straight out flying to the arctic way better than canadian north and given the fact that there are only two options.....
reviews.author: JP G

reviews.title: First Air Puts Customers First
reviews.text: As my fresh-from-the-oven chocolate chip cookie cools in front of me after a nice hot meal and a bottomless glass of wine, I’m reminded that First Air offers travelers an experience that is a cut above. We are all in business class. Babies, workers, moms, dads, elders and executives are equally pampered. My “special coffee” arrives with whipped cream on it. What?!?! There is a delicious lacing of liqueur to be savoured. I didn’t ask for special treatment. I’m at the back of the plane, yet I am in first class. If you EVER have the delightful opportunity to visit our vast Canadian northland, I highly recommend First Air. The staff and service are exemplary.
reviews.author: BirdBrain2011

reviews.title: great plane with comfortable seats and leg room
reviews.text: while we had a huge departure delay (another plane was on the runway with a busted tired and couldn't be moved), the plane was a pleasant surprise. Very nice crew although the snack offer late in the evening wasn't exactly what we were looking for. But the whole thing wasn't their fault. Overall I would recommend this airline
reviews.author: mwhamburger

reviews.title: outstanding crew
reviews.text: We had 2 flights in the Arctic with First Air as part of our holiday and I can say I have never met such cheerful and happy crew on any flight, ever. It just made the whole experience more pleasant, great teamwork and well done!
reviews.author: Vivien N

reviews.title: Great trip on First Air to Nunavut!
reviews.text: We had a great trip up to Nunavut from Ottawa in April 2018 and then back in May 2018. Everything about this airline is great. They provide good food and the crew was very helpful and friendly. There aren't a lot of options for flying that far north but First Air is great. We have traveled with them before and were very impressed with this airline.
reviews.author: ewosborn

reviews.title: Great handling the Arctic weather
reviews.text: With Arctic travel, weather is the #1 boss. Our flight out of Resolute Bay was initially delayed by fog, then cancelled. They tried it again the next day, but this time the weather in Resolute was good enough to go, after they de-iced the plane, and this was mid-August! The flight was supposed to land in Arctic Bay, but the fog there didn't allow for a landing, and we felt sorry for the passengers who were planning to go there, as they had to continue on to Iqaluit. Otherwise, we had a good flight. It was reassuring to know that this airline knows the weather, and knows when it is safe go or to land or not, and we are good with that. Do remember that this airline only allows one free checked bag, and will charge for any extra checked bags. We thought the interior of the cabin could have been a touch cleaner, i.e. the overhead bins.
reviews.author: Ben B

reviews.title: Good basic service in a remote part of the world with its challenging weather conditions
reviews.text: Despite the pouring rain, our flight left Iqaluit on time. After take-off, our very friendly flight attendant served hot beverages and cookies, which is the extent of the on-board service on this particular flight. First Air does serve a good selection of excellent Inuit teas which we enjoyed and recommend you try - thanks First Air to introducing us to this fine product. The best part of the trip was our flight attendant - he made a point of engaging with and chatting with all this passengers, making the flight more comfortable and feel shorter than it was. We thought the interior of these ATR aircraft could be cleaner (a "Magic Eraser" on the overhead bins would make a world of difference), and the windows were very scratched.
reviews.author: Ben B

reviews.title: One of a kind
reviews.text: This was my first time flying with First Air, one of a handful of airliner that flies long distance in the northern parts of Canada. This flight did not have business class, however, everyone got provided with the same amenities. Every passenger received a meal (hot choice between pasta or beef), complimentary wine (house red/white) and a "special" coffee (coffee with alcohol) and snacks before landing. The only disappointing element to this flight was that it was delayed departing by 1 hour, because we were waiting for passengers who's connecting flight was late. This in turn, made me miss my next connection. When travelling in the north, one has to understand that delays or outright cancellations can easily occur because of weather or any other reasons. As such, be prepared to wait and just enjoy the moment.
reviews.author: Stefan P

reviews.title: Nice flight
reviews.text: Really enjoyed my flight with First Air -- The landing was smooth. The staff is very friendly, and they serve an inflight meal. I expected the worst flying to a northern destination -- being that the Winnipeg landing (on a different airline) was rough.
reviews.author: Peter R

reviews.title: Flight experience
reviews.text: Courteous staff. I am a little nervous about fliying but this flight was okay and the pilot was very good at informing us about what to expect during the flight. Kudos they landed when it was foggy in Iqaluit. Excellent equipment planes have. Food was okay.
reviews.author: jeeseemailee

reviews.title: Packed like Arctic sealice.
reviews.text: Friendly service, in flight hot meal and free non-alcoholic drinks all nice. However passengers are packed in as tightly as sea lice on a fresh walrus head and anyone over 6 feet should do their best to get an exit row seat or fly the other airline. Seat lumbar support nonexistent and one struggles to stay seated upright. The most uncomfortable flight I’ve ever taken simply due to limited seat and leg space. No inflight entertainment.
reviews.author: NannaCar

reviews.title: Flight experience was very good. Flight crew very friendly and accommodating.
reviews.text: Nicer plane than CDN North's. The flight I was scheduled for from Iqaluit to Ottawa was cancelled outright due to a windshield replacement on the cockpit, but we were left hanging at the airport for a total of 7 hours, probably 3 hours longer than we needed to be, before we were all dispatched to the First Air desk to be put up in hotels and given meal and taxi vouches. The flight left the next day (23 hours later) - many people missed family events down south.
reviews.author: Jo W

reviews.title: Comfortable and friendly
reviews.text: I have mobility issues but found that First Air was very accommodating and helpful. The meal was palatable and nutritious. Beverages were offered throughout the flight and the hot cookie was a tasty treat. Sadly the fares are expensive as is most things in the North.
reviews.author: tantecarol

reviews.title: Not pleased at all..!!
reviews.text: One of the worst customer service I have ever received. My entire Business travel was planned from Iqaluit.. Arctic Bay.. Resolute Bay and back to Iqaluit. I specifically booked my meal preference as VEGETARIAN, but somehow the staff screwed up and I ended up eating a small pack of pretzels for all of my meals. I was even told by the flight attendant that no flight in Nunavut provides vegetarian meal and I should complaint to the authorities about my discomfort. During my entire journey, all they provided is a pack of pretzels. Plus all flights had very small legroom. Not going to travel with First Air anymore.
reviews.author: rutzz91

reviews.title: Big plane to a small place
reviews.text: We took the flight from Ottawa to Iqaluit, and, several days later, the flight back to Ottawa. Both went smoothly. The plane had a 3 by 3 configuration with about 25 rows of seats. I had the impression that the flight attendants knew several of the passengers, as there aren't many flights to Iqaluit. The general atmosphere on the flight was friendly. We got a meal on the morning flight from Ottawa, and on the afternoon flight from Iqaluit, we got two glasses of wine (from a box), as well as a meal. Food service started about an hour after takeoff. There were actually several empty seats, but I understand this isn't always the case. We were worried about possible cancellations due to weather, but everything went well. Views of the Canadian North from the plane were impressive. The cost of the ticket was, naturally, very high, although we flew at a time when the airline had put on a special price that was only half of the normal price.
reviews.author: rhudson2018

reviews.title: A flight with hot food nice attendents
reviews.text: A nice flight to Miami for a Celebrity Cruise. Flight was on time, friendly attendants with beverages and hot meals provided. Smallish seats but it was only 3 hours. Friends fly FirstAir to Nunavat with the same praise.
reviews.author: Rednecksx2

reviews.title: Best ever
reviews.text: Very friendly staff. Great service! Hot meal and beveridge wa a very pleasant surprise! Plenty of leg room and clean.
reviews.author: CathyAnz64

reviews.title: First Air and Celebrity Cruises
reviews.text: This is a great airline with friendly staff, hot meals and drinks and no luggage charge for our occasion, The only negative is that when we arrived in Miami, we had to walk for about 35 minutes to get to our bus. Celebrity said it was about a 10 minute walk. Resolved on return trip., we had to deplane outdoo9rs and proceed in the cold for about 6 minutes prior to entering the building
reviews.author: donf456

reviews.title: EXCELLENT SERVICE TO RANKIN INLET
reviews.text: First Air flies charter for Calm Air on their 737s. The front end of the jet is fit for cargo so you are in the 'back' relatively speaking. The staff were amazing. One of the flight attendants grabbed a baby from a young mother as she was trying to figure how to get back to the rest room. He solved her problem by taking over the baby duties in a heat beat. Now that's service. The meal was good, hot coffee and you even get a hot towelette to freshen up at the start. While they are the only show in town they do an excellent job.
reviews.author: SenorGancho

reviews.title: First Air rocks!
reviews.text: Excellent and attentive cabin staff, clean plane interior and flight included meal and beverage service!! We were super shocked at this service but that is the way flying was not too long ago. The staff and service made the flight a very pleasant experience.
reviews.author: kazimieraa2018

reviews.title: Never a good experience.
reviews.text: They always charge an abhorrent amount of money for baggage, and constantly delay and cancel more than the other carrier. I have a special request meal, which never comes so I end up starving. I didn't book with them again, my work did, however, never again.
reviews.author: Kyle J
